page.layout: One page of text in a single column. A marginal note stands in the left margin beside the line "propatulo". The catchword "Atq;" sits at the lower right. The page number is at the top left and the running head at the top centre.

main_text.p: ras: siqué claro & sincero, non autem præstigiis Iesuiticis cæcato animo ea intuens, omnem tucum & fallaciam cernere queas. Quodsi, vt spero, facis, non dubito, quin iã nunc ex iis, quæ in quauis nostra probationis domo, ad erudiendos & iuxta normam Societatis instituendos nouitios iaciuntur, spiritualibus fundamentis intelligas: neminem prorsus huic esse religioni aptum, nisi qui vel naturalé quandam, vel seruili educatione acquisitam, vel stupore quodam animi arreptâ propensionē habeat ad hypocrisin & superstitionē: nempè qui manifestâ quâdam oris pietate, vultusq; totius benignitate devotionem, quam vocant, sciat suam prodere in Matth. 6. [?]propatulo, quã tamen Christus abscondere iussit in cubiculo: quíve publicè orans, non aliter ac Pharisæus ieiunans, faciem nouerit suam exterminare: quæ cùm verissima sit hypocrisis, à nostris tamen ædificatio appellatur & devotio. Equidem hoc esse Societatis nostræ fundamentū, indies magis magisq; perspicio, atq; valdè etiâ deploro: neq; prius animus conquiescet meus, quàm ex his sordibus emersero. Tu verò si diuturnâ consuetudine quasi altera natura impeditus, illud fortassis necdum vides, efficiam profectò, vt vel solo id tactu, sensuum omnium stupidissimo illo quidem, sed sincerissimo, & qui minimè depravari possit, cognoscas.
Fateor fanè, inquam, Paule, me ista nondum videre: quare si tenebris me Iesuiticis circumfusum arbitraris, fac, si potes, tactu falsè [?], cuius-modi ea sint, vt cognoscam.

page.notes: The marginal note at the left is partly faint; its reference "Matth. 6." is read as "Mat.6." and is doubtful. The reference mark for that note is not visible in the text, so it is placed beside the line it sits against. The word "falsè" in the second paragraph is doubtful. The page number "io" is read as the old form of "10". The catchword "Atq;" is at the lower right, on the line of the last full line.
